Candidate regions are flagged to READ — NOT auto-judged.
monitors.rationale: B1 of docs/CONCEPT_COVERAGE_IMPLEMENTATION_INDEX — the concept/CLAIM-level check the four token-level coverage detectors structurally cannot do: a WRONG PREDICATE on a correctly-spelled, correctly-seeded object (the VR-95/1023/1026/1027 arc; consumes the A1 negative facts is_galois=false / field_role=root). Identity-targeted (not co-occurrence) + heavy window-exclusion (corrected-status chunks, negation/quote/correction/closure cues, ^{gal}, subfield-of, the correct relative Gal(stem_i/stem_j)); positive/negative-control validated and 0 false-positives on the cleaned corpus, while surfacing genuine residuals (VR-66, VR-521: 'Gal(stem_2/Q)=S_3≀S_3'). CANDIDATE-emitting, never an auto-verdict (a window cannot separate assert-P from quote/negate/adjacent-correct-P). Scope = the verification_ready/ chunk corpus AND the canonical definition docs via scan_files (CLAUDE.md/study_guide/outline — not chunked, so scanned directly; closes the reachability gap), with §15 dated changelog rows skipped and a table-cell pattern added for glossary-table mislabels. SDValidate borrow (axis-7, SCOPED): the level matcher was widened from the six seeded levels {₁₂₃₄₅₆ₖ}/[123456k] to ANY level (subscript run [₀-₉ₖ]+ or _digits/_k, + a leading (?<![0-9A-Za-z]) guard) — the unseeded-OBJECT coverage SDValidate's type-property outliers buy, here as a low-FP identity-shape sweep rather than a full statistical outlier model (the full SDValidate — flag a fact whose value is an outlier vs the property's type distribution — is DEFERRED; see docs/CONCEPT_COVERAGE_IMPLEMENTATION_INDEX §3). Validated: strict superset of the seeded patterns, 0 new doc FP, positive control 'Gal(stem_7/Q)=S' flagged, negative controls (ecosystem₇, Xstem_7, stemma) miss.

monitors.rationale: AUDIT-222 F2 re-baseline; AUDIT-225 §6 tolerance recalibration. The prior max=315 read 350>315 INFO-UNMET, but that was a STALE CONSTANT not a regression: the +35 was the DANGLING_FILE_REF axis-5 added by commit 7af1de67 (2026-06-17), and the substantive DANGLING_REF had FALLEN to 117 (the old 180/94/41/165 decomposition was never reconciled to the 5-axis tool output; 165 unverifiable, grounding_report.json gitignored). AUDIT-223 re-baselined to the true total 350 but with ZERO tolerance, so it tripped at the next +1 benign DANGLING_FILE_REF (351) — recreating the per-pass noise AUDIT-222 fixed. Tolerance widened to 365 (~+4%), matching the +tol style of the substantive DANGLING_REF guard, so benign churn passes while a real multi-axis jump still trips.
